item.title: Release 2026.11.20.2109 (build 17)
item.description:
Summary

  • 🐷 Fixes for to-dos now read the correct due date instead of a phantom deadline property — no more date confusion!
  • 🚀 Coda write pacing is smarter and more reliable, with retries for 429 rate-limit hiccups so things keep moving smoothly.
  • 🧰 Craft trash handling got a big glow-up: tasks in trashed documents are now properly excluded, and matching is faster thanks to a cached trash snapshot.
  • 🎯 Board pills now show source notices instead of triage counts, making the status display clearer and more useful.
  • 📚 Added docs confirming the live Craft trash-matching behavior, so the pig trail is nicely documented too!

Details

  • [Fixed] fix(things): read the to-do's due date, not a nonexistent deadline property (BUN-347)
  • [Fixed] fix(coda): pace writes under the measured rate limit and retry 429s (BUN-346)

  • [Fixed] fix(craft): leave out tasks in trashed documents (BUN-324)

item.title: Release 2026.11.19.2305 (build 15)
item.description:

  • 🚀 You can now open Claude session links directly in Claude Desktop, and notes also accept native Codex thread links — talk about smoother handoffs!
  • 🎯 The board and focused quest views now show notes alongside the quest, including note chats and working folders, so everything you need is right there in one tidy pigpen.
  • 🧭 New guided quest handoffs make it easier to jump into the right work, and agents now ask which source to create a quest in before creating it.
  • 📏 Hand-offs now stay under Claude’s prompt limit, so long drafts won’t trample the fence anymore.
  • 🎛️ UI polish alert: the focused quest notes pane is better organized, focused quest/notes cards are separated, and collapsible count badges make the board easier to scan.
  • 🛠️ Small but mighty fixes: duplicate snooze punctuation is gone, and focused description scrolling now behaves properly beside notes.

item.title: Release 2026.11.18.1633 (build 13)
item.description:

  • 🐷 **MCP writes now speak up!** Agents can report when writes are **accepted or rejected**, so you get clearer feedback on what happened.
  • 🚀 **New `search_quests` MCP tool added!** A fresh way to search quests right from the agent side — oinkcredible for discovery.

  • 🏷️ **Release versions now include tag time.** That means clearer version tracking and fewer “which build was that?” mysteries.

item.title: Release 2026.11.17 (build 11)
item.description:
Summary

  • 🎉 You can now **open Claude Desktop directly with a prompt for a quest** — instant launch, less clicking, more doing.
  • 🐷 The board got a **big glow-up**: you can **multi-select On Deck quests and defer them together**, plus see **agent chat links on cards** and open a shiny new **notes sheet** right from the board.
  • 📝 **Quest notes are here!** Notes now work across **Things, Coda, Craft, and Linear**, with a proper notes model and managed section support so your piggy little notes stay organized.
  • 🛠️ MCP just got much beefier: there’s now a **Settings → Agents pane**, a **tools-only MCP server**, **quest board tools**, and agents can run over a **user-only Unix socket with a stdio bridge**. Oink yeah.
  • 🔧 Important fix: **in-flight MCP replies now still get delivered even after the client stops sending**, so conversations won’t get cut off mid-snort.
  • 🧱 Craft support is more reliable now too: **single tasks are read via `GET blocks?id`**, and Craft notes are stored as **child blocks inside the task page** for better verification and syncing.

Details

  • [Added] feat(agents): open Claude desktop with a prompt for a quest
  • [Added] feat(board): multi-select On Deck quests and defer them together
  • [Added] feat(board): show agent chat links on cards and add a notes sheet
  • [Added] feat(mcp): add Settings → Agents pane and document the MCP surface
  • [Added] feat(mcp): serve agents over a user-only Unix socket with a stdio bridge
  • [Added] feat(mcp): add tools-only MCP server and quest board tools
  • [Added] feat(defer): batch Another Day with one write per source

  • [Fixed] fix(mcp): deliver in-flight replies after the client stops sending
